title: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding Technique
content:
The 5-4-3-2-1 technique anchors you in the present moment by engaging all five senses:
1. Notice 5 things you can SEE around you (e.g., a spot on the wall, the way light hits a surface).
2. Notice 4 things you can physically FEEL or TOUCH (e.g., the texture of your shirt, feet on the floor).
3. Notice 3 things you can HEAR (e.g., birds chirping, humming of a fan, distant cars).
4. Notice 2 things you can SMELL (or favorite scents you remember, like coffee or fresh rain).
5. Notice 1 thing you can TASTE (or take a gentle sip of cold water).

title: Box Breathing (Square Breathing)
content:
Box breathing regulates your autonomic nervous system and lowers heart rate:
1. Inhale deeply through your nose for a count of 4.
2. Hold your breath gently for a count of 4.
3. Slowly exhale through your mouth for a count of 4.
4. Pause and hold the empty lungs for a count of 4.
Repeat this cycle 4 to 5 times while resting your hands on your lap.

title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation (PMR)
content:
Progressive Muscle Relaxation helps release physical somatic tension:
1. Start with your feet: curl your toes tightly for 5 seconds, then completely release and feel the warmth.
2. Tense your calves and thighs for 5 seconds, then let go.
3. Make tight fists with your hands, squeeze your arms, hold, and release.
4. Scrunch your facial muscles and shoulders up toward your ears, hold for 5 seconds, and let your shoulders drop completely.
5. Notice the contrast between tension and deep relaxation.
